name: GENIUS
intro: GENIUS（Generative Fluid Intelligence Evaluation Suite）用 510 个专家策划的多模态图像生成样本评估生成式流体智能，覆盖隐式模式归纳、即时约束执行和情境知识适应。每题各模态共同构成必要证据，并配人工交叉验证的 RC/VC 提示；发布版未标准化模型推理，但固定官方仓库公开了混合评测代码。
org: Peking University, CUHK, StepFun, PolyU, MSRA
build_method: 专家策划多模态样本, 必要模态约束, 评测提示至少三轮交叉验证
metric: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature: 3 轮评分, 每轮 RC/AQ 各一次, VC 与抄袭检查逐图像标签提示调用, 仅含 <image:...> 时计入 VC
scale: 510个样本、3个维度、5个任务、20个子任务
intro_en: GENIUS evaluates generative fluid intelligence with 510 expert-curated multimodal image-generation samples spanning implicit pattern induction, ad-hoc constraint execution, and contextual knowledge adaptation. Every modality supplies necessary evidence and items carry cross-validated RC/VC hints. The release does not standardize model inference, but the pinned official repository publishes the hybrid evaluator.
build_method_en: Expert Multimodal Curation, Necessary-modality Design, At Least Three Rounds of Evaluation-hint Cross-validation
metric_en: Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality
eval_feature_en: 3 Scoring Rounds, RC/AQ Once per Round, VC and Copy Checks per Image-tag Hint, VC Included Only for <image:...> Hints

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against GENIUS arXiv:2602.11144v1, official repository commit 115338d60588594b0fe2a0bbbf8f6b9136a7d0da, and Hugging Face dataset revision a1c68adcd67912c690efaf45fc19bdff58c3259d. The 510 expert-curated samples split 86/213/211 across Implicit Pattern Induction, Ad-hoc Constraint Execution, and Contextual Knowledge Adaptation; the second splits into Symbolic Constraint 153 and Visual Constraint 60, while the third splits into Prior-Conflicting 101 and Multi-Semantic 110. The release has five tasks and 20 subtasks, with context, id, instruction, rc_hint, sub_dimension, and optional vc_hint fields. Every modality is necessary and evaluation hints undergo at least three cross-validation rounds. The repository README declares CC-BY-NC 4.0 for data and code, while the pinned Hugging Face (HF) dataset card declares MIT; this official-source license conflict is preserved rather than resolved. The release does not standardize or publish model inference scripts; it expects outputs/<model>/<task>/<id>.png. The evaluator runs 3 scoring rounds. RC and AQ are called once per round; VC is called once per image-tag hint per round, with copy checks also performed per image-tag hint. VC is included only when a vc_hint contains an <image:...> tag. Pinned symbolic item 015 has a non-empty vc_hint but no <image:...> tag, so the evaluator must omit VC for that item. It parses exact Rule Compliance, Visual Consistency, Aesthetic Quality, and Copy labels, assigns zero on parse failure or missing output, averages and rounds the three rounds, maps 0/1/2 to 0/50/100, averages available metric values, and computes overall = 0.6 RC + 0.35 VC + 0.05 AQ.
